title: The Pre-Compass Dark

features.name: void-compass
features.desc-on-touch: A compass rose carved where no north exists. All four points glow the same faint colour, equally meaningless.

features.name: lost-sextant
features.desc-on-touch: Instrument for reading sky-position. Here there is no sky. It spins in all directions at once, seeking reference that will not come.

features.name: baseline-stripped
features.desc-on-touch: Every edge you find is perpendicular to every other edge. The geometry is perfect and tells you nothing.

features.name: echo-of-bearing
features.desc-on-touch: A sound like 'north' in a language that has no directions. The word means nothing here. It fades and loops back.

inscription: here all four directions folded into one and then vanished; up and down learned they were the same mistake; the archive read itself and saw only recursion.

file.name: Sextant_Logs_Unmapped_Sector.txt
file.note: Navigation records from before north existed. Checksums match but coordinates describe no space that contains this archive.

exits.label: back up toward the moment when direction still meant something
sideways toward cardinal spaces learning to remember themselves
into zones where even the dark forgets it was ever dark
deeper still into the folds where all positions become the same position
